description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: The great day of God is near, a day of wrath against Judah and Jerusalem for their idolatry and complacency.
1.sw: Siku kuu ya Mungu iko karibu, siku ya ghadhabu dhidi ya Yuda na Yerusalemu kwa ajili ya ibada yao ya sanamu na kutojali kwao.
1.am: ታላቁ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ቀርቧል፤ ስለ ጣዖት አምልኮአቸውና ስለ ግዴለሽነታቸው በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ የቍጣ ቀን ነው።

2.en: Zephaniah calls the humble to seek God before the day comes, and announces judgment on the Philistines, Moab, Ammon, Cush and Assyria.
2.sw: Sefania anawaita wanyenyekevu wamtafute Mungu kabla siku hiyo haijafika, na anatangaza hukumu juu ya Wafilisti, Moabu, Waamoni, Kushi na Ashuru.
2.am: ሶፎንያስ ትሑታን ቀኑ ሳይደርስ እግዚአብሔርን እንዲፈልጉ ይጠራቸዋል፤ በፍልስጥኤማውያን፣ በሞዓብ፣ በአሞናውያን፣ በኩሽና በአሦር ላይም ፍርድን ያውጃል።

3.en: Woe to Jerusalem, whose leaders are corrupt. God will purify the nations and leave a humble remnant, and God will rejoice over Zion with singing.
3.sw: Ole wake Yerusalemu, ambao viongozi wake ni wapotovu. Mungu atayatakasa mataifa na kuacha mabaki wanyenyekevu, na Mungu atafurahi juu ya Sayuni kwa kuimba.
3.am: መሪዎቿ ብልሹዎች ለሆኑባት ለኢየሩሳሌም ወዮላት። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቦችን ያነጻል፤ ትሑት ቅሬታንም ያስቀራል፤ እግዚአብሔርም በጽዮን በዝማሬ ደስ ይለዋል።
